summary: Ziyad Jaber Alhdriti is a Software Engineering student at Umm Al-Qura University in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with an expected graduation year of 2027 and a GPA of 3.73/4.00. Since 2026 he has been a Software Engineering and Business Analysis intern at the Holy Makkah Municipality, where he analyses and documents the requirements and business cycles behind digital services, models the procedures as process maps, and works inside cross-functional Agile teams. His engineering profile spans full-stack web development with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase and Tailwind CSS, and mobile development with Flutter, Dart, Swift and SwiftUI. He emphasises production readiness: enforcing access rules inside PostgreSQL with Row Level Security, and covering them with pgTAP and Vitest tests. His academic foundation includes object-oriented programming, data structures, database systems, software requirements engineering, UML modeling, software testing, SDLC, system design, and system integration. His projects include the Bayn Cultural Club event-management platform (Next.js, Supabase, Postgres RLS, MFA-protected admin console, Telegram and WhatsApp notifications, pgTAP tests), a Wedding Greetings live-event message wall shipped for a real wedding (QR onboarding, 1080x1350 cards generated in the browser with the Canvas API, serverless Supabase backend, localStorage drafts for weak venue Wi-Fi), the WASL student transportation and accommodation graduation project (Flutter, Dart, Spring Boot, Java, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Agile Scrum, with booking, service workflows, ratings and admin management across Student, Provider and Admin roles), and H2O Calm, a self-taught Swift and SwiftUI iOS prototype for tracking daily water intake with local persistence. His certifications include Python 101 from Satr and a 30-hour Flutter Application Development Bootcamp from Hash Plus. He has completed more than 262 verified volunteering hours through the National Volunteering Platform in Saudi Arabia, contributing to digital outreach, charitable awareness, community support, coordination, and operational tasks. Languages: Arabic native or full proficiency, English professional working proficiency.
